description: Built-in tools: Read, Bash and Edit, all allowed by the app's permission policy without asking.

command.text: Do these one at a time, using the tools named: 1. Read notes.txt with the Read tool. 2. Run `wc -l notes.txt` with the Bash tool. 3. Use the Edit tool to change the line apple to apricot in notes.txt. Then reply with just: done
